task.description: WF-02 Step 1: produce the design artefact for REQ-042 (Definition full-text search, store.zig PD-10). Branch feature/WF02-REQ042-20260817 already exists and is checked out. Write lib/letflow/design/search.md covering a new search/1 function (likely added to the existing Letflow.Definitions module, or a new module -- your call, reasoned) operating on REQ-027's process_definitions table via Ecto, no new migration. Read docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-042 entry in full, plus lib/letflow/definitions.ex for existing query patterns (Repo usage, prefix-scoping conventions from create/2 and get_by_id/2) and lib/letflow/definitions/process_definition.ex for the schema fields (name, description, stage, created_at).
acceptance_criteria: search/1 signature specified: input (query string, opts with limit/offset), output (ranked list of definitions or a distinct error)
QueryEmpty-equivalent error specified for empty query string
QueryTooLong-equivalent error specified for query > 512 chars
Ranking design specified: exact name match (case-insensitive) = 3.0, partial name match = 2.0, description-only match = 1.0, ordered by rank DESC then created_at DESC

ILIKE-based matching with parameters bound safely -- explicit design note that the '%' wildcard characters are composed into the bound parameter value itself, never string-interpolated into query text (SQL-injection safety)
Pagination (limit default 20, offset default 0) specified -- function itself does not need to reject an out-of-range limit >100, only apply the default (S4 HTTP layer's job)
No-match case returns an empty list, not an error
Design explicitly states no new migration/table is added, citing this as a design constraint per REQ-042's description

Tenant-scoping: must follow the same prefix/opts pattern REQ-030's create/2 and get_by_id/2 already use (read lib/letflow/definitions.ex to confirm the exact pattern) -- this is a tenant-scoped read query, same as export_import.ex's export/2
Each of REQ-042's 6 acceptance criteria maps to a concrete design element, no TBD/deferral
No implementation code in the design doc -- signatures and type shapes only

result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/search.md for REQ-042 (Letflow.Definitions.search/2, extending the existing definitions.ex context module -- no new module, no new migration/table/index). Design: query :: String.t(), opts :: [prefix, limit, offset] (extends the established opts()/prefix pattern from create/2, get_by_id/2, list/2 -- resolved via TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 identically). Explicitly flagged and resolved the 'search/1' vs 'search/2' naming tension (requirements.yaml/req030's boundary table say 'search/1', inherited from R-Co's single-struct Store.search(options) call; this task's own AC text describes two inputs -- query string + opts-with-limit/offset -- matching every sibling function's 2-arity tenant-scoping shape, so this design implements search/2 and documents why). Ranking: WHERE name ILIKE %q% OR description ILIKE %q%, rank via a single fragment/1 CASE (lower(name)=lower(query) -> 3.0, name ILIKE %q% -> 2.0, ELSE 1.0 -- safe because the WHERE clause already restricts rows to a name-or-description match), ORDER BY rank DESC, created_at DESC. Two distinct validation errors ({:error, :query_empty} for byte_size(query)==0, {:error, :query_too_long} for byte_size(query)>512, byte-length not grapheme-count, flagged as OQ-1). SQL-injection-safety invariant (INV-SR-2): '%' wildcards composed into the bound ^pattern value in Elixir, fragment SQL text is a fixed literal, never spliced. Pagination: limit default 20 / offset default 0, explicitly NOT clamped to a max here (diverges from list/2's clamp-to-200, per REQ-042's own text assigning >100 rejection to S4) -- flagged as OQ-2 for negative/zero values. No-match -> {:ok, []} via Repo.all/2's own empty-result behavior, no special branch. INV-SR-1 states no new migration/table/index (confirmed against req027's shipped schema, which already omitted R-Co's idx_def_name/idx_def_fts on purpose) and specifies the exact moduledoc text ELIXIR-DEV must add citing PD-10. All 6 requirements.yaml acceptance criteria and all 11 handoff acceptance criteria mapped to concrete design sections in a traceability table (doc section 12). No implementation code -- @type/@spec declarations and Ecto query-structure prose only, no .ex code blocks.
